summary: c1 concerns cleanup added by g0002 and was not applicable before that change. c2 is the same parser lifetime failure on both versions: the old harness returns on a parse error before freeing its parser.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established the target coverage obligation; this turn assesses only when it arose.

before.requirement: Exercise release of an unattached saved comment in parser_free.
before.reason: The before-version parser_free has no release of last_comment, so this specific changed behavior did not yet exist.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment saving already existed before the cleanup was added.

after.requirement: Exercise parser_free with an unattached saved comment after a parse error.
after.reason: The new release is conditional on last_comment. The unchanged harness uses flags 0 and returns before parser_free on an error.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Saving a block comment requires UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.

claims.comparison_reason: The release operation was added in g0002. The old target’s fixed flags and error return prevent it from running after the change.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established the parser lifetime obligation; this turn assesses only whether the failure predates the changes.

before.requirement: Free the parser created for an input that produces a parse error.
before.reason: The one-byte input { produces an unmatched-brace error on the before source, and the harness returns before its only parser_free call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before-version parser_free releases parser-owned state and the parser.
The error accessor returns the stored parse error.

after.requirement: Free the parser created for the same input when it produces the same parse error.
after.reason: The unmatched-brace error and the harness’s early return remain; the added comment cleanup does not free a parser when parser_free is never called.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The after-version parser_free remains the parser release operation.
The error accessor still returns the stored parse error.

claims.comparison_reason: The same input, parser allocation, parse error and early return leave the parser unreleased on both versions.
